notes.title: EOPRISM | KickStarter & GDC Showcases
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341886/67dcb12842c37893df5ba99f94ad7e77fc6379ee.png
EOPRISM is now available on Kickstarter!
After the amazing feedback from our players we're looking to use the extra expenses to expand to more gamers on the Nintendo Switch 2 alongside add a few cool people to the game (unannounced voice actors).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341886/cd92f846b3f0785968803d97098ca741459cdf94.png
Outside of that we'll be at the Game Developers Conference (GDC) next week demoing our game. After a fun Super MAGFest and Steam Next Fest we've been invited to more game events! Early in the week the game will be available at The Mix | Kinda Funny Spring 2025 Showcase and Pocket Gamer Connects SF. Our CEO will be speaking at GDC as well. We'll have much more exciting news afterwards!
